forbidden: test PUMP-10..12 telemetry, snapshots, predictions and labels (no new run, no inspection)
rewriting results/release or any earlier result
data_scope.allowed_shared_static: assets.csv (shared static passport incl. test rows) is parsed, then filtered to train rows before use; shared parquet files are read through train asset predicates and the returned IDs are asserted

emission.refractory: unchanged vendor (per B1 fault type, 12 h)
emission.note: Alert times are exactly B1's; only class/type/confidence/evidence/action/channel are re-assigned. Official matching may still change.

candidates.W1: waveform rules on B1 MACHINE alerts only; abstain -> exact B1
candidates.M1: ExtraTrees minute features; override if top class != NORMAL and score >= 0.6; else exact B1
candidates.X1: cross-class fusion: decisive W1 overrides ANY non-protected B1 type (machine or sensor); else M1 (0.6); else B1. Risk: a simultaneous sensor problem can be overwritten by a machine waveform result; the official denominator exposes it.

fallback: learner abstention / unsupported / NORMAL output / absent model -> exact B1 row (evidence and action retained); never healthy

waveform.availability: latest VALID snapshot with timestamp + n_samples/sample_rate <= clock; never nearest/future
waveform.reference: median of >= 2 valid snapshots completed within the first 24 h; used only at clocks >= reference end; reference count reported per clock = records completed by then
waveform.spectrum: remove mean, periodic Hann, rfft, amplitude 2|X|/sum(w); 1 s record -> 1 Hz bins

envelope.filter: Butterworth order 4 SOS, sosfiltfilt within the one completed record
envelope.floor: median envelope amplitude in [0.5, 1.5] x BPFO excluding the line half-width
envelope.band_choice: broad generic high-frequency band; public TECHNICAL_MODEL mentions a 2.8 kHz resonance, which lies inside; band not tuned
envelope.band_rule: upper edge = min(5000, 0.45 x sample_rate) = 4608 Hz at 10240 Hz

w1_thresholds.wording: one radial axis is consistent with, not proof of, the fault

learner.minute_features: per B1 channel key: present_, z_, zs_ (current minute; masked unless installed in passport and count>0 and finite mean), ztrail_ (mean of observed z over 15 trailing rows incl. current; installed only)
learner.missing: clip +-50.0, missing -> sentinel -1000.0 plus indicator; no fitted imputation
learner.training_population: fit-asset minutes after the reference where B1 would diagnose from deviations: steady, B1 _zmax > k where _zmax = max(max|z|, max(zs)/2) over channels, not gap, not steady flatline
learner.labels: event fault_type inside the PHYSICAL interval max(onset, detectable)..end (or window end) of exactly one observable event and inside no other event's scoring window; NORMAL outside every event scoring window (incl. 6 h early / 30 min late allowances) and every physical interval; excluded: unobservable windows, overlaps, scorer buffer outside the physical interval, COMMUNICATION_LOSS/SENSOR_STUCK
learner.groups_and_weights: each event = one group; each contiguous NORMAL candidate segment = one group; each group total weight 1 over <= 240 evenly spaced minutes. The NORMAL class total weight therefore equals its episode count; its effect on scores relative to the thresholds is not known before scoring
learner.support: a class is fitted only with >= 2 groups on >= 2 fit assets; dropped classes recorded per fold; fewer than 2 classes -> no model -> B1
learner.folds: 7 LOAO folds; fit on the six other train assets; held-out labels never passed to fit or inference; frame row IDs and waveform maps asserted
learner.score_semantics: uncalibrated ExtraTrees predict_proba (average of leaf class distributions); not a probability of fault
learner.unseen_types: a fault type absent/unsupported in the fit assets cannot be predicted for the held-out asset; disclosed per fold
learner.sensor_channel: only a unique installed, currently observed channel with |z|>k or spread z>k; otherwise unlocalized (no channel credit)
learner.evidence: observed deviations at the alert minute (stated as observations, not model attribution); fused decisions add waveform status, snapshot id, completion, age and derived features; model_id per fold

gates.success: detected>=18, class>=14, false+excess<=6, sensor type+channel>=3, AND (type>=10 OR (type>=9 AND sensor type+channel>=4))
gates.selection: useful diagnoses (correct type; SENSOR also needs channel) desc, correct type desc, false+excess asc, candidate id
correctness: prefix replay and future mutation (minute windows ending > cut; snapshots completing > cut) at every alert, reference end -1/0/+1/+60 s, 3 snapshot completions and age boundaries -1/0/+1 s per asset, 5 random cuts (rng seed 0)
two fresh-process determinism hashes per candidate

runner.attempts: each attempt writes results/diagnosis_fusion/run-<UTC>/ (never overwritten; partial failed runs preserved); COMPLETED.json written only at the end and blocks any further score
runner.before_scoring: run_provenance.json: manifest/code hashes, train-only input projection hashes (assets/features/snapshots/events/benign rows of PUMP-01..07), per-fold fit assets, feature names, classes, support, unsupported classes, ExtraTrees params, fitted-tree state SHA-256, prediction SHA-256 per candidate; raw predictions_<c>.csv
runner.audit_calls: each candidate audited through its production call; B1 receives no waveform state (as in production); other candidates compared on every output column incl. waveform provenance
runner.determinism: two fresh PYTHONHASHSEED=0 child processes; per candidate both child hashes must equal the main scored prediction hash
